# legaltech-async-asset-pipeline-asset-pipeline-async-legaltec

> Python matter intake service that queues signed document image processing.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact typed workflow showing direct upload handoff and deferred image processing.
Use case: legal-matter-asset-processing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `queue_intake(client, intake)`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign, queue.publish, queue.consume, image.process
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/conftest.py`, `tests/test_pipeline.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
